verdict.rationale: Edge0 documents an OpenAI-compatible `edge0 serve` endpoint, but nothing shows a command that launches third-party coding agent CLIs pre-configured to use local models. The compatible API is only a building block a user could wire up manually, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can launch popular third-party coding agent CLIs pre-configured to use my local models with a single command
